skills.name: software-factory-routing
skills.description: Route a multi-stage software-factory task to the smallest useful set of skills; use when work spans discovery, implementation, assurance, or release.

skills.name: software-factory-specification
skills.description: Turn ambiguous software-factory requests into observable behavior contracts and acceptance cases before consequential implementation.

skills.name: software-factory-planning
skills.description: Plan coupled software changes with dependency order, reversible increments, evidence gates, and architecture decisions.

skills.name: software-factory-implementation
skills.description: Implement a bounded software change or diagnose a reproducible failure using focused tests, causal experiments, and small reversible edits.

skills.name: software-factory-context
skills.description: Reduce stale or excessive agent context while preserving the behavior contract, evidence identity, unresolved risks, and authorized scope.

skills.name: software-factory-review
skills.description: Review a software change for actionable correctness, maintainability, and regression risks; simplify only when behavior preservation is demonstrable.

skills.name: software-factory-interfaces
skills.description: Design or validate API and user-interface boundaries, including compatibility, accessibility, browser behavior, and failure states.

skills.name: software-factory-security
skills.description: Assess and remediate concrete software-factory trust-boundary risks such as authorization bypass, injection, secret exposure, and dependency compromise.

skills.name: software-factory-performance
skills.description: Diagnose and improve measured latency, throughput, memory, or token efficiency while preserving correctness and workload comparability.

skills.name: software-factory-delivery
skills.description: Prepare and execute authorized software releases, CI changes, or migrations with artifact identity, compatibility checks, and recovery evidence.

skills.name: software-factory-operations
skills.description: Investigate runtime incidents and improve observability around software-factory outcomes, retries, reconciliation, and recovery.

skills.name: software-factory-improvement
skills.description: Run bounded evaluation-driven hill climbing on prompts, skills, retrieval, or workflow configuration while preserving fixed acceptance gates and protected final evaluations.

skills.name: software-factory-verification
skills.description: Define behavior contracts and verify critical software-factory or agentic workflows against safety, liveness, authorization, and concurrency properties. Use for assurance design, specification-gap analysis, or verification impact analysis; not routine feature implementation.

skills.name: software-factory-evals
skills.description: Design, execute, and analyze evaluations of coding agents and stateful agent workflows in a software factory. Use for behavioral regression suites, fault scenarios, grader design, and candidate comparisons; not generic unit-test authoring or model-provider selection.

skills.name: software-factory-outcome-validation
skills.description: Validate whether a software-factory change achieved the intended business outcome and whether release or production evidence supports acceptance. Use for acceptance reviews, residual-risk decisions, runtime-control validation, and post-release outcome checks; not merely checking that tests passed.
